observations: A roughly circular skull-like form sits centered on a flat teal-grey ground, built from overlapping black fills and dense multicolor scribble lines in teal, red, orange, purple, and white.
A thick yellow diagonal bar enters from the upper left and cuts across the upper third of the composition, one of the few hard-edged shapes against the surrounding tangle.
The lower jaw shows a row of blocky tooth forms in dark olive and black framed by white lines; the eye sockets are hollow black voids ringed with looping color marks.
reading: The skull form holds its ground at center while color lines—teal loops, red slashes, white spirals—pull outward in every direction, giving the image a taut, contained quality. The yellow bar cuts through without merging, reading as something foreign lodged in the structure. The hollow eye sockets and clenched jaw suggest pressure rather than stillness. The collector reads this layered line density as a visual relative of scrimshaw's incised surfaces.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #207 and nnxyz nnotb #209 share the same teal-grey ground and skull-centered format. Title order and recorded creation order align for this work.

connections.reason: nnxyz nnotb #207 uses the same teal-grey ground and a large circular skull form, but its interior is dominated by broad warm orange masses where #208 fragments color into finer crossing lines.
nnxyz nnotb #209 shares the tooth-row and hollow-socket structure but shifts to a near-black ground and introduces a spiral eye detail absent in #208.

lookingQuestion: Where does the yellow diagonal bar begin and end relative to the skull's outer edge, and what happens to the lines that cross it?
ambiguities: nnxyz nifty faces #112 shows a structurally different architectural face form; no strong formal connection to #208 was found and it was omitted from connections.
Metadata notes gaps and variants may exist elsewhere in the nnotb family, though title and recorded creation order align for this work.
